title: DNAME Redirection in the DNS
summary: The DNAME record redirects a whole subtree of the DNS: every name ending in a given suffix is mapped to the same part of another tree. It obsoletes RFC 2672 and updates RFC 3363.

eli5.summary: If a street gets a new name, a sign sends everything on the old street to the new one, not one house at a time.
